# Fixture sources

Each fixture is a snapshot of one public repository at one commit: its file list and the text of the few files the items read (README, manifests, CI workflows, agent instruction files). Those texts belong to their projects and are redistributed here under each project's license, only to pin the scorer's output in `test/fixtures.test.ts`.
